AGENTS.md

R package: scDE v0.2.0.9000. Single-package repo (no monorepo). Unified DGE for Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, and AnnData single-cell objects.

Developer commands

devtools::document()    # regenerate man/ + NAMESPACE (roxygen2)
devtools::load_all()    # interactive dev
devtools::check()       # CRAN-style check
pkgdown::build_site()   # docs site

No test suite exists. testthat is in Suggests but tests/ directory does not exist.

Generated files — never hand-edit

NAMESPACE and all man/*.Rd are generated by roxygen2 (RoxygenNote: 7.3.3). Always run devtools::document() after changing any @ tags. Manual edits will be overwritten.

Dependencies — non-CRAN remotes

Two deps are GitHub-only and must be installed from the org fork:

remotes::install_github("amc-heme/presto")   # NOT the CRAN presto
remotes::install_github("amc-heme/SCUBA")    # internal org package

BPCells is a conditional runtime dep (used inside run_dge.Seurat for IterableMatrix) but not listed in DESCRIPTION. Install separately if working with BPCells matrices.

AnnData / Python path

run_dge.AnnDataR6 calls reticulate::source_python() on inst/extdata/python/scanpy_dge.py at runtime. Python env must have scanpy, anndata, pandas.

CI pins Python 3.11 with a virtualenv named "r-reticulate". Locally, set RETICULATE_PYTHON or call reticulate::use_virtualenv() before using the AnnData method.

AML_h5ad is a function — call AML_h5ad(), not data(AML_h5ad).

S3 dispatch

run_dge dispatches on object class: - Seurat → presto (presto::wilcoxauc) or BPCells (BPCells::marker_features) based on matrix class at runtime - SingleCellExperiment → presto (presto::wilcoxauc) for in-memory matrices, scran (scran::pairwiseWilcox or scran::findMarkers) for DelayedArray-backed matrices; backend controlled by test_use param - AnnDataR6 → Python scanpy via reticulate - default → warning + NULL

Output column normalization by backend

Each backend produces different raw names; they’re normalized to a common schema. Key renames: - Presto: padj → pval_adj, logFC → log2FC - BPCells: foreground → group, p_val_raw → pval, foreground_mean → avgExpr; pval_adj added via BH - AnnData: names → feature, logfoldchanges → log2FC, pvals → pval, pvals_adj → pval_adj

Final sort: group, pval_adj, desc(abs(log2FC)).

Known limitations / gotchas

  • run_dge.AnnDataR6 ignores the layer param entirely — always uses X matrix. This is acknowledged in the code.
  • BPCells path uses object[[seurat_assay]]$data hardcoded (Assay5), not layer-parameterized.
  • slot param deprecated in 0.2.0, replaced by layer. Removal at 1.0.0.
  • SingleCellExperiment method uses scran for Wilcoxon testing. Requires Bioconductor: BiocManager::install(c("scran", "SummarizedExperiment")) — listed in Suggests, so not auto-installed. Guards use requireNamespace() with actionable error messages.
    • Default layer: "logcounts".
    • Backend controlled by test_use param (also on the generic, ignored by other methods):
      • NULL (default): auto-detects — "Presto" for in-memory matrices, "scran" for DelayedArray-backed (e.g. HDF5Array).
      • "Presto": presto::wilcoxauc on the extracted matrix directly (.default method). Output matches Seurat/presto schema: includes auc, pct_in, pct_out. Errors informatively if matrix is DelayedArray.
      • "scran": true one-vs-rest via scran::pairwiseWilcox per group; result indexed directly by pair position (avoids combineMarkers, which fails in scran ≥1.36). Binary factor with explicit levels c(g, "other") ensures g is always in pairs$first. Returns auc column. LFC computed from group means (subtraction in log space, divided by log(2) to yield log2FC). avgExpr via MatrixGenerics::rowMeans2() (supports DelayedArray); other_mean derived algebraically — no additional matrix reads.
      • "scran_pairwise": scran::findMarkers(pval.type = "any") pairwise approach. log2FC computed from group vs. all-other-cells means (same algebraic method as "scran") — findMarkers wilcox output has no reliable summary LFC (scran bug, unfixed as of 1.40). No auc column.
  • Package uses %>% (magrittr), not base |>.

CI

.github/workflows/pkgdown.yaml only builds/deploys pkgdown site. No R CMD check or test CI runs.
